Directional balance with poster friendly contrast
challenge: Translating the visual language of Russian Constructivism into a modern generative art series. The goal was to create poster-ready compositions with bold geometric forms, strong directional cues, and high contrast that communicate purpose and movement through pure visual structure.
approach: Used Adobe Firefly to lay out core geometry and axis lines, then refined edges, contrast steps, and typographic rhythm cues through careful in-painting and value adjustment. Each panel was treated as a self-contained poster composition within the unified series.
result: Delivered a six-piece constructivist collection with crisp, poster-ready panels that read instantly in tile grids and retain sharp structural detail at print scale. The series demonstrates confident command of geometric composition rooted in art-historical precedent.
